parts.text:
Solid H decomposes when heated to make a solid and a gas.
The student investigates the loss in mass when solid H is heated.
Procedure
The student:
Step 1 puts some solid H into a test-tube
Step 2 heats the test-tube for 1 minute
Step 3 lets the test-tube cool down
Step 4 measures the mass of the test-tube and contents
Step 5 records the mass in Table 2.1.
The student repeats Steps 2, 3, 4 and 5 on the same test-tube six more times.
